notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect or missing for return-trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The discount is mapped in mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch from dispatch.report.price.discount, while return-trip logic (station swap, line item mapping) lives in create-reservations.mappers.ts. The mismatch likely occurs because the discount amount is not correctly adjusted or propagated when the order contains a return trip — the return trip handling may not carry the discount through, or may carry the full discount instead of the per-segment amount.

notes: Openspec provided an empty acceptanceCriteria array with good root-cause analysis notes. I created all ACs from scratch based on the defect description and the technical notes about the mismatch between mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch and return-trip logic in create-reservations.mappers.ts. Key additions: (1) core happy-path AC for return-trip promo display, (2) regression safeguard for one-way trips, (3) no-promo return-trip case, (4) partial/segment-only discount edge case, (5) explicit guard against the two most likely failure modes (doubling vs. dropping the discount), (6) zero-value discount edge case, (7) data-layer verification at the sanitized dispatch level, (8) visual/formatting consistency between one-way and return-trip confirmations.
